mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teachers (user_id, school_id, subject, bio, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{schoolId}, #{subject}, #{bio}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE teachers SET subject = #{subject}, bio = #{bio}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sc.code_name, '기타') AS subject, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN pa.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) ) AS rate FROM problem_attempts pa JOIN problems p ON pa.problem_id = p.problem_id LEFT JOIN system_codes sc ON p.subject_code_id = sc.code_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY p.subject_code_id, sc.code_name ORDER BY rate DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(ls.started_at), '%m/%d') AS week, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT ls.student_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE school_id = #{schoolId}), 0) ) AS rate FROM learning_sessions ls JOIN students s ON ls.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND ls.started_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 WEEK) GROUP BY YEARWEEK(ls.started_at) ORDER BY MIN(ls.started_at) ASC

SELECT COALESCE(sc.code_name, '기타') AS unitName, COALESCE(sub.code_name, '기타') AS subject, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN pa.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) ) AS avgAccuracy, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.student_id) AS studentCount FROM problem_attempts pa JOIN problems p ON pa.problem_id = p.problem_id LEFT JOIN system_codes sc ON p.unit_code_id = sc.code_id LEFT JOIN system_codes sub ON p.subject_code_id = sub.code_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND p.unit_code_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.unit_code_id, sc.code_name, p.subject_code_id, sub.code_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY avgAccuracy ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT u.name AS name, st.student_level AS level, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(ls.started_at, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) THEN ls.solved_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weekStudy, COALESCE(ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(ls.session_id), 0) ), 0) AS assignRate, COALESCE(ROUND( SUM(ls.correct_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ls.solved_count), 0) ), 0) AS correctRate, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ls.started_at), '%m/%d'), '-') AS lastAccess FROM students st JOIN users u ON st.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN learning_sessions ls ON st.student_id = ls.student_id WHERE st.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY st.student_id, u.name, st.student_level ORDER BY u.name ASC
